attributes.title: New tab, on your start page
A lab inventory for things you keep or buy, or an organism database for animals you house

childNodes.textContent: A lab inventory for things you keep or buy, or an organism database for animals you house
Vials or plates in racks inside incubators: genotype, purpose, crosses, egg collection, flip schedule and temperature shifts.

attributes.class: card flex flex-col gap-2 p-4 no-underline transition-all hover:border-brand-300 hover:shadow-sm

childNodes.textContent: Fly vials in racks inside incubators. Label a vial with its genotype and purpose; set crosses, collect eggs into new vials and keep racks flipped.

attributes.class: card flex flex-col gap-2 p-4 no-underline transition-all hover:border-brand-300 hover:shadow-sm

childNodes.textContent: Worm plates in boxes inside incubators. Chunk boxes on schedule, set crosses and pick progeny onto new plates, and keep frozen stocks thaw-tested.
Samples, orders, reagents, antibodies or a list of your own, with freezer boxes, mine / lab common stock, and status boards. Pick one to name it.

attributes.class: card flex flex-col gap-2 p-4 no-underline transition-all hover:border-brand-300 hover:shadow-sm

childNodes.textContent: Harvested tissue, blood, DNA and RNA, traced back to the animal they came from and kept in freezer boxes.

attributes.class: card flex flex-col gap-2 p-4 no-underline transition-all hover:border-brand-300 hover:shadow-sm

childNodes.textContent: What the lab has asked for and where each order stands, on a board from requested to received.

attributes.class: card flex flex-col gap-2 p-4 no-underline transition-all hover:border-brand-300 hover:shadow-sm

childNodes.textContent: Chemicals, buffers, enzymes and kits. Keep your own stock apart from the lab's common shelf.

attributes.class: card flex flex-col gap-2 p-4 no-underline transition-all hover:border-brand-300 hover:shadow-sm

childNodes.textContent: Chemicals by name, abbreviation, CAS number and molecular weight. A Formulation in the notebook picks them from here and works out the moles from what you weigh.

attributes.class: card flex flex-col gap-2 p-4 no-underline transition-all hover:border-brand-300 hover:shadow-sm

childNodes.textContent: Primary and secondary antibodies with host, clone, conjugate, validated applications and working dilutions.

attributes.class: card flex flex-col gap-2 p-4 no-underline transition-all hover:border-brand-300 hover:shadow-sm

childNodes.textContent: Viral vectors — AAV, lentivirus, rabies and more — with serotype, titer, the plasmid each was made from, biosafety level and aliquots in −80 °C boxes.

attributes.class: card flex flex-col gap-2 p-4 no-underline transition-all hover:border-brand-300 hover:shadow-sm

childNodes.textContent: Primers, probes and guide oligos by sequence: length, GC and Tm are worked out from it, and Add primer pair makes the forward and reverse at once.

attributes.class: card flex flex-col gap-2 p-4 no-underline transition-all hover:border-brand-300 hover:shadow-sm

childNodes.textContent: Bacteria carrying each plasmid, frozen in glycerol: the plasmid, strain, colony, how it was checked, and where each tube sits in the −80 °C boxes.

attributes.class: card flex flex-col gap-2 p-4 no-underline transition-all hover:border-brand-300 hover:shadow-sm

childNodes.textContent: Frozen vials of each line and clone: passage, freeze date, cells per vial, mycoplasma tests, and where each vial sits in the LN₂ boxes.

attributes.class: card flex flex-col gap-2 p-4 no-underline transition-all hover:border-brand-300 hover:shadow-sm

childNodes.textContent: An empty list. Pick the features you need and add your own columns.

attributes.class: grid size-5 place-items-center rounded-full bg-brand-600 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white

childNodes.textContent: A preset fills in the nouns, capabilities, schedule rules and fields that organism's community actually uses. Everything stays editable afterwards.

attributes.class: card flex flex-col gap-2 p-4 no-underline transition-all hover:border-brand-300 hover:shadow-sm

childNodes.textContent: Plots in a field, raised first in a nursery and transplanted. Sowing and harvest dates, seed lots from each harvest and the generation of each line.
A field is a grid of plots: give it rows and columns, and place each plot in it. The days are rice-like: change them for your crop.

attributes.class: card flex flex-col gap-2 p-4 no-underline transition-all hover:border-brand-300 hover:shadow-sm

childNodes.textContent: Individually tracked animals in cages, litters weaned at P21. The shape the rest of this engine was generalised from.
A bespoke mouse colony module already ships with this app; this preset is the reference expression of it in the configurable engine.

attributes.class: card flex flex-col gap-2 p-4 no-underline transition-all hover:border-brand-300 hover:shadow-sm

childNodes.textContent: Plants in pots and trays in growth rooms or a greenhouse. Each sowing has its date, harvests become seed lots that are sown again, and generations (T1, T2, F2…) follow along.
No sexes and no animal protocol. The days in its schedule are Arabidopsis under long days: change them for your species.

attributes.class: card flex flex-col gap-2 p-4 no-underline transition-all hover:border-brand-300 hover:shadow-sm

childNodes.textContent: Tanks on a recirculating system. Groups with a headcount, individuals when one gets fin-clipped, plus a nursery stage.
A bespoke zebrafish module already ships with this app. This preset exists so the generic engine can be checked against it, and for labs that would rather run fish on the configurable engine.
